scope: One Litterbugs website, steady 30-day hosting estimate before tax; existing external services and migration work excluded.

observed.ready_deployment_caveat: Production-target READY records are a proxy, not proof every deployment published to a custom domain. Retaining equivalent publishing cadence is a modeling assumption.

budget_assumptions.cloudflare_cache_storage_and_ops: Assumed below included/free allowances; actual adapter architecture not yet benchmarked.
budget_assumptions.photo_processing: Existing Supabase storage retained. No separate paid image-processing server assumed. Compatibility must be demonstrated before quoting Cloudflare as migration-ready.
budget_assumptions.render_memory: $7 instance has 512MB; if insufficient for photo processing, next 2GB instance is $25 before extras.

netlify.pricing_note: Current browser pricing displayed Personal $9 and Pro $20. Purchase/account quote governs; no subscription created.

cloudflare.range_note: $2 contingency for adapter/cache/processing differences; not an observed bill or guaranteed cap.

vercel.scope_note: Shared existing Pro plan; migrating Litterbugs alone does not cancel it while other business projects still need Pro.

limitations: Cross-host compute metrics are not identical; provisioning, caching and builds require a trial measurement.
